title: Stop arguing with what already stands
summary: The Creator acts everywhere; peace begins when the self stops claiming private authorship. Peace begins where argument with Hukam starts ending.
takeaway: Peace begins where argument with Hukam starts ending.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: The Creator acts everywhere; peace begins when the self stops claiming private authorship.
source.lifeApplication: Before resistance takes over the room, name what is already here and return the moment to the Creator's care.
